portInfo.description: The Municipal Port Fund of Samos oversees island harbours including Vathy (Samos town), Karlovasi and Pythagoreio. Its site states that the port of Samos town and Pythagoreio provide cruise handling. Passengers must not assume Vathy if the ship is assigned to Pythagoreio.
